sha256sum.name: sha256sum

sha512sum.name: sha512sum

slice.name: slice
slice.description: To get partial elements of a list, use `slice list [n] [m]`. It is equivalent of `list[n:m]`. - `slice $myList` returns `[1 2 3 4 5]`. It is same as `myList[:]`. - `slice $myList 3` returns `[4 5]`. It is same as `myList[3:]`. - `slice $myList 1 3` returns `[2 3]`. It is same as `myList[1:3]`. - `slice $myList 0 3` returns `[1 2 3]`. It is same as `myList[:3]`. `slice` panics if there is a problem while `mustSlice` returns an error to the template engine if there is a problem.

snakecase.description: Convert string from camelCase to snake_case.

sortAlpha.name: sortAlpha
sortAlpha.description: The `sortAlpha` function sorts a list of strings into alphabetical (lexicographical) order. It does _not_ sort in place, but returns a sorted copy of the list, in keeping with the immutability of lists.

substr.name: substr
substr.description: Get a substring from a string. It takes three parameters: - start (int) - end (int) - string (string)

swapcase.name: swapcase
swapcase.description: Swap the case of a string using a word based algorithm. Conversion algorithm: - Upper case character converts to Lower case - Title case character converts to Lower case - Lower case character after Whitespace or at start converts to Title case - Other Lower case character converts to Upper case - Whitespace is defined by unicode.IsSpace(char)

ternary.name: ternary
ternary.description: The `ternary` function takes two values, and a test value. If the test value is true, the first value will be returned. If the test value is empty, the second value will be returned. This is similar to the c ternary operator.

toDate.name: toDate
toDate.description: `toDate` converts a string to a date. The first argument is the date layout and the second the date string. If the string can't be convert it returns the zero value. `mustToDate` will return an error in case the string cannot be converted. This is useful when you want to convert a string date to another format (using pipe). The example below converts "2017-12-31" to "31/12/2017".

toDecimal.name: toDecimal

toJson.name: toJson
toJson.description: The `toJson` function encodes an item into a JSON string. If the item cannot be converted to JSON the function will return an empty string. `mustToJson` will return an error in case the item cannot be encoded in JSON.

toPrettyJson.name: toPrettyJson
toPrettyJson.description: The `toPrettyJson` function encodes an item into a pretty (indented) JSON string.

toRawJson.name: toRawJson
